react_native_issues.issue: FIX VERIFIED: shim now returns { isLoaded: true, isPlaying: player.playing } (src/utils/av-shim.ts:22-24). No deprecated packages involved - expo-audio ~57 used correctly, no expo-av. Note: shim's getStatusAsync hardcodes isLoaded:true even if the player failed to load; acceptable for this usage since play failure is caught silently and degrades to visuals-only.

No testID props anywhere on player controls (play/pause/skip/music toggle), tab chips, or header add buttons. Tests had to rely on computed-style/geometry heuristics (68x68 play button, 42x42 add gradient) and exact text, which are brittle. Also dangerous: get_by_text('Manifestation', exact=True) matches the FEATURED card's category text inside its Pressable, so clicking it navigates to /discover-detail instead of selecting the tab chip. Reference: components/feature/AudioAffirmationPlayer.tsx, app/(tabs)/discover.tsx:188

action_items: No required fixes - both reported bugs verified FIXED on web preview.

Recommended: on a real device (Expo Go/native build), confirm audible playback - web preview proves the mp3 loads (HTTP 206) and player state machine runs, but actual sound output can't be asserted headlessly.
Recommended: add testID props to AudioAffirmationPlayer controls (play-pause, skip-back, skip-forward, music-toggle), Journal/Vision header add buttons, and Discover tab chips for robust automation.
Optional: give the Discover featured card's category meta text a distinct wrapper so exact-text selectors can't accidentally trigger its navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: journal.tsx:253 uses colors={[c.primary, c.primaryDark]} - matches vision.tsx:779 exactly; verified live in both themes (dark #A855F7->#7C3AED, light #C4707A->#A85560). Old ['#A855F7','#EC4899'] gradient fully removed.

av-shim.ts:22-24 getStatusAsync added returning { isLoaded: true, isPlaying: player.playing } - satisfies AudioAffirmationPlayer.tsx:212-213 (`const status = await snd.getStatusAsync(); if (status.isLoaded) await snd.playAsync();`). Empirically: play tap -> no console error, network fetch of SoundHelix mp3 (206), progress/ambient/wave visuals all active.

Player reset effect (AudioAffirmationPlayer.tsx:182-196) pauses music, zeroes progress/idx and stops waves on categoryLabel change - verified across Manifestation/Mindset/Meditations switches with no stale state or errors.

Note (pre-existing, not from this fix): Discover tab chip text is not uniquely selectable - the featured card overlay also renders an exact 'Manifestation' text node inside a navigation Pressable; automation (and potentially accessibility tooling) can hit the wrong target.

rca_of_issue: REVIEWED BUGS (fixed by E1, verified by T1): (1) Journal + button hardcoded ['#A855F7','#EC4899'] - fix replaces with theme colors; verified rendered gradient equals Vision's in BOTH dark (rgb(168,85,247)->rgb(124,58,237)) and light (rgb(196,112,122)->rgb(168,85,96)) themes, old pink absent. (2) Affirmation Audio silent on play - root cause as reported: AudioAffirmationPlayer.handlePlay called snd.getStatusAsync() which did not exist on the expo-audio-backed shim; the throw was swallowed by the empty catch so playAsync() never ran. Fix adds getStatusAsync to the shim. Empirically verified: no console errors on play, SoundHelix mp3 fetched (HTTP 206 range request), progress advances, pause halts it, skips change affirmations, tab switches reset cleanly.
